receipt.exact_amortized_note: Exact latency is amortized from a batched chunked matmul over all 10000 sampled users at once (throughput regime), not a single-query call; ANN latency above is measured single-threaded, one query at a time (serving regime). These are different serving regimes and are not directly comparable as a speedup ratio without that caveat.

note: Demo-facing artifact only. Every kind='eval' / kind='paired_delta' record in this log uses exact full-catalog ranking via chunked matmul (CLAUDE.md invariant #4); this ANN index is never in that code path and does not affect any reported metric.

params.holdout_predicate: (ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00') AND pmod(xxhash64(user_id, parent_asin, ts), 1000) < 50

params.insert_predicate: (ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00') AND pmod(xxhash64(user_id, parent_asin, ts), 1000) < 50
params.update_predicate: NOT ((ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00') AND pmod(xxhash64(user_id, parent_asin, ts), 1000) < 50) AND (ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00') AND pmod(xxhash64(parent_asin, user_id, ts), 1000) < 20
params.merge_condition: t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.parent_asin = s.parent_asin AND t.ts = s.ts
params.merge_sql: MERGE INTO local.ops.interactions_monthly t USING late_batch_ops_t20 s ON t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.parent_asin = s.parent_asin AND t.ts = s.ts WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET * WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

params.delete_sql: DELETE FROM local.ops.interactions_monthly WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2023-06-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00'
params.fragmentation_design: delete month, re-append in daily slices from a materialized scratch copy — simulated micro-batch ingestion for the compaction exhibit
